This block sits 7.9 to 4.9 weeks out from the qualifier, so it is a prepeak specificity build block rather than a taper. The classic lifts stay heavy and frequent, front squat is held with a meaningful but controlled dose, back squat and pulling strength stay on maintenance, and accessory work stays lean while you manage the routine 4 kg cut. Weight-making itself stays outside this program.

Weeks 2-3 add only the written kilos on the classic lifts if the prior week stayed inside the RPE and technique caps. Week 4 is a consolidation week: main-lift intensity stays moderate, but support volume drops so you finish the block fresher without losing feel.

Do your usual wrist prep before every rack session. If the rack position is more than mild discomfort or it changes turnover, dip-drive, or lockout, hold the first pain-free load, cut the last work set, and use the Back Squat maintenance dose instead of same-day Front Squat only if the front rack stays provocative. If symptoms linger after the session, repeat the last clean week rather than forcing the next jump.

TAPER AUDIT
Event: strength meet, priority A, about 7.9 weeks out.
This block does not reach the event: it is a build block, and the taper comes later.

W4  prepeak specificity  50    12         42%               21          8         87%

Across the block: volume -19 sets, exercises unchanged, competition-lift share +3 points, peak effort unchanged, accessory volume -9 sets.
